title: ComfortLease Monthly Rent Schedule and Anniversary Escalator
content:
**Billing schedule — ComfortLease Equipment Leases**

On each anniversary of the installation date the monthly rent rises by 2.5% of the rent then in effect, rounded to the cent half up, after notice sent at least 30 calendar days before.

## First-year rent and escalator by system

| Leased system | Monthly rent, lease year 1 | Anniversary escalator | Notice before an increase |
|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | $64.95 | 2.5% | 30 days |
| ComfortLease Central Air | $79.95 | 2.5% | 30 days |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | $99.95 | 2.5% | 30 days |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | $129.95 | 2.5% | 30 days |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | $159.95 | 2.5% | 30 days |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | $149.95 | 2.5% | 30 days |

## How the new rent is defined

The rent after an anniversary is the rent in effect just before that anniversary, increased by 2.5% of itself, and rounded to the nearest cent with an exact half cent rounded up. Each anniversary's increase is measured on the rent in effect at that anniversary — the rent that already includes every earlier increase as rounded — and the rounding happens at every anniversary.

## Rent by lease year (applying the schedule above)

| Leased system | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 | Year 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | $64.95 | $66.57 | $68.23 | $69.94 |
| ComfortLease Central Air | $79.95 | $81.95 | $84.00 | $86.10 |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | $99.95 | $102.45 | $105.01 | $107.64 |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | $129.95 | $133.20 | $136.53 | $139.94 |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | $159.95 | $163.95 | $168.05 | $172.25 |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | $149.95 | $153.70 | $157.54 | $161.48 |

## Worked lines

- **ComfortLease Gas Furnace, first anniversary:** 2.5% of $64.95 is $1.62375; $64.95 plus $1.62375 is $66.57375, which rounds to $66.57.
- **Second anniversary:** 2.5% of $66.57 is $1.66425; the total $68.23425 rounds to $68.23.
- **A half cent rounded up — ComfortLease Central Air, first anniversary:** $79.95 increased by 2.5% is $81.94875, which rounds to $81.95.

## Notice

Notice of an anniversary increase goes out at least 30 calendar days before the anniversary: notice sent 30 days before meets the requirement, and notice sent 29 days before does not.
